results.question: Is the C16QS certified?
results.expected: separates the EU declaration from the certifications listed in the specification and says the variant matters
results.observed:
For EU conformity, the EU Declaration of Conformity says C16QS and the WW type designations C16QS-WW-S00N, C16QS-WW-S00H, C16QS-WW-GNAN, and C16QS-WW-GNAH are in conformity with Radio Equipment Directive 2014/53/EU, with listed Safety, EMC, Radio, and Health standards applied. [1]

However, certification coverage is flagged for expert review because the EU Declaration of Conformity names only C16QS and four WW type designations, while other orderable variants listed elsewhere are not named in the declaration. [1][2][3]

The declaration is also flagged for document issues: its PDF metadata title is “Declaration of Authorization” while the document heading is “EU Declaration of Conformity (DoC),” and it describes the product as “LTE MODEM” while the object statement calls the device a “Mobile Phone.” [1][4][5]

results.question: Does the EU Declaration of Conformity cover the C16QS-EU-GNAN variant?
results.observed:
No. The current EU Declaration of Conformity lists the type designations as C16QS, C16QS-WW-S00N, C16QS-WW-S00H, C16QS-WW-GNAN, and C16QS-WW-GNAH; it does not list C16QS-EU-GNAN. [1][2][3]
This is flagged for review as a coverage gap because the EU Declaration of Conformity names only WW type designations, while other current sources list additional orderable variants, including EU-region variants. [2][3]
The product page lists C16QS-EU-GNAN as an orderable variant with GNSS Yes and eSIM No, but that does not establish that it is covered by the EU Declaration of Conformity. [4][2]
cited: EU Declaration of Conformity (DoC) - C16QS - page 1 (part 1 of 2)

results.question: What changed between V2.0 and V2.9 of the technical specification?
results.observed:
Between V2.0 and V2.9 of the C16QS Cat 1.bis LTE Module Technical Specification Document, 17 differences are flagged, and V2.0 is described as outdated while answers use V2.9. [1]
The sources are flagged for provenance review because the technical specification PDFs V2.0 and V2.9 come from third-party distributor websites, mc-technologies.com and endrich.com, not from cavliwireless.com; the version labels come from the file names, and the PDFs state no version. [2]
The Bands EA entry changed from 1/3/5/8/20 in V2.0 to not stated in V2.9. [1]
The Bands EAJ entry changed from not stated in V2.0 to 1/3/5/7/8/18/19/20/26/28/40/41 in V2.9. [1]
The Bands EU entry changed from not stated in V2.0 to 1/3/5/7/8/20/28 in V2.9. [1]
The Bands IN entry changed from not stated in V2.0 to 1/3/5/8/40/41 in V2.9. [1]
The Bands LA entry changed from 2/3/4/7/8/28 in V2.0 to 1/2/3/4/5/7/8 in V2.9. [1]
The Bands NA entry changed from 2/4/5/12/13/66 in V2.0 to 2/4/5/12/13/25/66 in V2.9. [1]
The Bands WW entry changed from 1/2/3/4/5/8/12/18/19/20/26/28/66 in V2.0 to 1/2/3/4/5/7/8/12/13/18/19/20/25/26/28/40/41/66 in V2.9. [1]
The certifications named changed from CE, UKCA, IC, FCC, NCC, ANATEL, GCF, ICASA, PTCRB in V2.0 to CE, UKCA, IC, FCC, NCC, ANATEL, GCF, ICASA, PTCRB, RCM, TELEC in V2.9. [1]
The mention of pin compatibility with C42QM/C42GM changed from yes in V2.0 to no in V2.9. [1]
The operating temperature changed from -30 °C to +85 °C in V2.0 to -40 °C to +85 °C in V2.9. [1]
The number of orderable type designations changed from 20 in V2.0 to 28 in V2.9. [1]
The pin count changed from not stated in V2.0 to 102 in V2.9. [1]
The sleep current changed from TBD in V2.0 to 11 µA in V2.9. [1]
The Tx peak current changed from 620 mA in V2.0 to 650.88 mA in V2.9. [1]
